propositions: An env-read helper function absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS is silently ignored by the scanner, causing its environment variables to be missing from the registry while the build passes
REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE are genuinely missing from docs/env-vars.md because _gate_str_pref is unregistered, despite being advertised in CLI help
The scanner must fail closed on unregistered helpers that take an environment variable name as a parameter, using a dataflow-based predicate instead of name-based heuristics
Adding a helper row for _gate_str_pref to KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS causes exactly two keys (REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE) to appear in the registry, confirming the mechanism

A parameterized-shim predicate identifying functions whose os.environ key expression references their own parameters is enumerable (9 occurrences across 557 files) and catches helpers that escape existing guards
The registry artifact must be regenerated after the fix to document the two newly visible variables, moving from 162 to 164 keys
